A fenced div with an identifier can be reused anywhere else in the document.

```markdown
::: {#house-style}
Commit early, commit often, and write the message for the reader.
:::

::: {reuse="house-style"}
:::
```

::: {#house-style}
Commit early, commit often, and write the message for the reader.
:::

The same content again, without writing it again:

::: {reuse="house-style"}
:::

`reuse-filter` transforms the content on the way in: `shift-headings=N` moves the headings, `take=N` keeps only the first N blocks, and `id-remap=old->new` renames identifiers so the copy does not duplicate them.

```markdown
::: {reuse="report" reuse-filter="shift-headings=1,id-remap=note->note-copy"}
:::
```

Tokens of the form `{{name}}` in reused content are filled in from `div-reuse.vars`.

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-div-reuse/>.
